It Takes Two - Charles Tolman - ACCU 2025 Short Talks
---

In this ACCU 2025 lightning talk, Charles Tolman explores the intersection of agile mindset, technical leadership, and Argentine tango in software development. Titled "It Takes Two," this engaging session blends personal experience, team dynamics, and artistic insight to highlight the deeper human aspects of programming and software engineering.

Drawing from over 45 years of experience, Tolman compares the roles of lead and follow in tango with the dynamics of technical leadership and collaboration in agile development teams. He emphasizes the importance of attention in software teams, noting that good leaders must also be good followers—an idea that resonates deeply with principles of dual-role collaboration, clean code, and modern system design.
